description: Use this when the person names a surf spot, a town or a country and you need the spot's id. country is a two-letter code (PT) to keep to one country. Not for spots near a place: use list_surf_spots_near. Answers surf spots whose name, town, area or country match the words in any order, plurals, case or a typo: each with its id, name, town, country, kind (beach break, reef, point) and which way it faces; the closest names when nothing matches; at most 50.

country.description: a two-letter country code: PT, FR, US

name: search_surf_spots
title: Search surf spots
